response.sql:
WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName,
         AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS AvgBytesPerMs
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(AvgBytesPerMs) AS OverallAvg FROM per_type
)
SELECT p.MediaTypeName,
       p.AvgBytesPerMs,
       p.AvgBytesPerMs - o.OverallAvg AS AboveOverall
FROM per_type p
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE p.AvgBytesPerMs > o.OverallAvg;

assumptions.assumption: Tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded by the Bytes >= 10323804 filter, and each media type's average is a simple AVG over its qualifying tracks, with the overall average being the simple AVG of those per-type averages.
Milliseconds is never 0 for qualifying tracks, since the schema does not prevent it and the query divides by it.
